item.tib: srid pa'i sgron me rgyal ba'i bka' brten gyi rnam bshad nyung thus rab gsal nyi 'od ngo mtshar 'bum ldan
item.coloph: ces rgyal ba'i bka' dang bka' rten gyi rnam bshad nyung thus 'di yang / snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon rig 'dzin gyim tsha rma chung dngos byon mchog spal rin po che tshe dbang rgyal po'am/ sum ldan gshen gyi drang srong ba/ mchog gis bka'i (bkas) nye bar bskul ba la brten nas/ skam rigs kyi sdom brtson sman ri'i mkhan ming pa nyi ma bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal du 'bod pas/ 'du gnas so bdun gyi nang tshan/ g.yas ru mkhar gdong gi bde gsal gsang phug tu/ nyams len thun mtshams su 'phral brtsams bgyis pas rtsa gsum lha dang srung ma'i bden mthus mchog sprul rnam gnyis kyi dgongs bzhed/ g.yung drung bstan pa'i don rnams lhun gyis grub cing / gegs med mtha' ru phyin pa'i bkra shis par gyur cig/
